description: This file defines the 'Email' class, which is part of the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It manages email entities, including email creation, sending, retrieval, attachments, relationships, and associated logic. The class extends Basic, includes various attributes for email properties, and incorporates methods for handling email lifecycle and related data.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Represents an email entity in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM with attributes for email properties and methods for managing email lifecycle, attachments, relationships, and sending logic.

methods.name: setLastSaveAndStoreInSentError
methods.description: Sets the last error code related to saving and storing email in the Sent folder, ensuring only one error is recorded at a time.

methods.name: getLastSaveAndStoreInSentError
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the last stored error code for save and store operations.

methods.name: setNonGmailSentFolderHandler
methods.description: Assigns a handler for managing Gmail-specific sent folder operations.

methods.name: getNonGmailSentFolderHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler managing Gmail sent folder operations.

methods.name: clearTempEmailAtSend
methods.description: Resets the temporary email object used during the sending process.

methods.name: createTempEmailAtSend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a temporary Email object for use during sending.

methods.name: getTempEmailAtSend
methods.description: Returns the temporary Email object used during the send process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes email cache path, sets email address, and loads configuration details.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that logs any unhandled save/store errors related to email.

methods.name: email2init
methods.description: Initializes the email UI component.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, currently supports 'ACL'.

methods.name: email2saveAttachment
methods.description: Saves a file as an email attachment for the new email 2.0 specification.

methods.name: safeAttachmentName
methods.description: Checks if the filename has a disallowed extension and appends .txt if necessary.

methods.name: email2ParseAddresses
methods.description: Parses a string of email addresses (To/Cc/Bcc) into an array with email and display name.

methods.name: email2ParseAddressesForAddressesOnly
methods.description: Parses email addresses strings into a simple array of email addresses only.

methods.name: email2GetMime
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on its location.

methods.name: sendEmailTest
methods.description: Sends a test email via SMTP or Sendmail to verify email configuration.

methods.name: decodeDuringSend
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in HTML content to decode special characters during email send.

methods.name: isDraftEmail
methods.description: Checks whether the current email object is a draft based on request and object properties.

methods.name: email2Send
methods.description: Handles the entire process of composing, attaching files, and sending an email, including drafts, templates, and various attachment types.

methods.name: getNamePlusEmailAddressesForCompose
methods.description: Generates a delimited string of names and emails for a given module and list of record IDs for compose screen.

methods.name: _arrayToDelimitedString
methods.description: Converts an array of email addresses or names into a single string separated by the configured separator.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to persist the email object, handle relationships, and validate email addresses.

methods.name: saveTempNoteAttachments
methods.description: Saves temporary file attachments as notes related to the email.

methods.name: saveEmailAddresses
methods.description: Normalizes and links email addresses to the email object.

methods.name: linkEmailToAddress
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a link between the email and an email address.

methods.name: cleanEmails
methods.description: Cleans and formats email address strings, optionally including names.

methods.name: saveEmailText
methods.description: Saves large text fields related to the email (description, html, raw source).

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an email record by ID and populates related data such as addresses and text fields.

methods.name: retrieveEmailAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses linked to this email record from the database.

methods.name: retrieveEmailText
methods.description: Loads large text fields (description, html, raw source) from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the email record and related data as deleted in the database.

methods.name: getForwardHeader
methods.description: Generates a header string with sender, date, and subject info for forwarding emails.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves and associates notes attached to this email.

methods.name: fillPrimaryParentFields
methods.description: Guesses primary parent entity from the email's 'from' address by checking Accounts, Contacts, Leads, and Users.

methods.name: cid2Link
methods.description: Converts reference to inline image Note into URL link in email HTML content.

methods.name: cids2Links
methods.description: Converts all cid: image links in email HTML content into URL links by fetching related notes.

methods.name: setFieldNullable
methods.description: Sets the database schema definition for a field to allow NULL values.

methods.name: revertFieldNullable
methods.description: Reverts schema modifications to set a field's nullability back to original.

methods.name: populateBeanFromRequest
methods.description: Populates an Email bean's fields from a given request array, including parsing email addresses and managing default values.

methods.name: attachNote
methods.description: Associates a Note object with this email as an attachment.

methods.name: handleBodyInPlainTextFormat
methods.description: Converts email body from HTML to plain text and assigns it to email in non-HTML format.

methods.name: sendOptInEmailToEmailAddressById
methods.description: Sends an opt-in email to an email address by its ID if auto-send is enabled in config.

methods.name: sendOptInEmail
methods.description: Deprecated method for sending an opt-in email using a template, related to EmailAddress confirmation flow.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Validates an email address string using PHP's FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL.

methods.name: setRecipientAddresses
methods.description: Adds email addresses to a SugarPHPMailer object, handling To, Cc, and Bcc addresses, with proper charset translation.

methods.name: isToUseSystemEmail
methods.description: Checks if email should be sent using system defaults based on configuration and email object type.

methods.name: validateSugarEmailAddressField
methods.description: Validates that specified email field is a string and logs errors for certain fields.

methods.name: setupAttachments
methods.description: Attaches files and embedded images to an email based on saved attachments and notes, handling bad extensions.

methods.name: setOutboundBasedSenderAddresses
methods.description: Sets email sender addresses from outbound email account into the mail object.

methods.name: setSystemBasedSenderAddresses
methods.description: Sets email sender addresses based on system email configuration.

methods.name: validateBeforeSend
methods.description: Uses a validator to check the 'from' address and logs errors if invalid before sending.
